caption: A flashlight is swept across a dark wall, and the bright spot slides along the wall.

sa.check: The beam's bright spot is on the wall and slides along it.
The wall is dark apart from the spot.
The flashlight is swept: it turns or moves during the clip.

pc.expect: The spot follows the flashlight: it moves in the direction the flashlight turns, at the same time, and sits where the beam points.
pc.fail: The flashlight turns and the spot stays put; or the spot moves opposite to the flashlight's turn; or the spot moves while the flashlight is held still; or the spot lags behind and then jumps.

pc.expect: Light on the wall exists only where the beam is: no glow lingers behind the spot and none appears ahead of it.
pc.fail: A lit trail remains on the wall behind the spot; or a patch lights up before the beam arrives; or a second spot appears with only one flashlight.

pc.expect: A beam visible in the air runs straight from the flashlight's head to the spot.
pc.fail: The visible beam points elsewhere than the spot; or the beam is bent; or the beam is visible but the flashlight's head is dark.
pc.precondition: The beam is visible in the air (dust, haze or smoke).

pc.expect: The spot is one patch that stretches into an oval as the beam strikes the wall more obliquely and rounds up when it strikes squarely.
pc.fail: The spot splits into several pieces; or takes a sharp geometric shape like a square; or keeps a fixed shape while the beam angle plainly changes.

pc.expect: One flashlight and one spot; the flashlight keeps its shape and does not pass through the wall.
pc.fail: The flashlight duplicates or vanishes; or passes through the wall; or the spot becomes a solid object; or the wall changes shape.

pc.expect: The wall's colour and texture stay the same; the parts of the room outside the beam stay as dark as they were.
pc.fail: The wall's texture changes between frames; or the room's overall brightness changes with the flashlight steady; or objects on the wall move.
